request.query: cart-service is returning 5xx errors after a deploy

report.summary: After the latest deployment, cart-service began returning 5xx errors, with the error rate spiking from a near-zero baseline to 15.00pp. No ERROR-level logs were captured for 5xx responses during the anomaly window.

likely_causes.title: Bug introduced by the recent deployment causing unhandled exceptions in cart-service
likely_causes.rationale: The metric anomaly indicates a sudden increase in 5xx responses immediately following the deploy, suggesting a code change that broke request handling.

supporting_evidence.detail: 5xx error rate emerged from a near-zero baseline, reaching 15.00pp (threshold-validated; anomaly_detected=True)

likely_causes.title: Logging configuration changed or logs are not being captured
likely_causes.rationale: No ERROR-level log entries for 5xx or 500 messages were found in the expected time window, implying logs may not be emitted or collected.

supporting_evidence.detail: 0 documents matched log query for ERROR level '500' messages
0 documents matched log query for ERROR level '5xx' messages

likely_causes.title: External dependency failure causing cart-service to return 5xx errors
likely_causes.rationale: A sudden spike in 5xx responses could also result from upstream services becoming unavailable, even if cart-service code is unchanged.

supporting_evidence.detail: 5xx error rate emerged from a near-zero baseline, reaching 15.00pp (threshold-validated; anomaly_detected=True)

next_steps: Review the recent deployment's code changes for potential bugs that could cause unhandled exceptions.
Verify that the logging configuration is correct and that ERROR-level logs are being emitted and collected.
Check the health and availability of any upstream services that cart-service depends on.
If a code issue is confirmed, roll back to the previous stable version and redeploy after fixing the bug.
